title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast Version with Up to 8x Speed Improvement

content_html:
OpenAI Developers officially announced the launch of the Ultrafast version of GPT-6.1Sol in the API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work platforms.

As an upgraded performance version, this version can run up to 8 times faster than the standard Sol version. In terms of pricing, it is 6 times the cost of the standard version. The specific charges are $12 (approximately 80.5 CNY) per million input tokens and $60 (approximately 402.7 CNY) per million output tokens.

In terms of applicable scope and permission access, this new feature has been officially launched in Codex and ChatGPT Work. It is available for Pro500 users, qualified pay-as-you-go enterprise plans, and education plans with quota-based billing. Enterprise users need to have their administrators activate the relevant permissions in the background.

Currently, the Ultrafast version of GPT-6.1Sol has been deployed in all supported regions and fully supports data residency compliance services in the United States and the European Union.
